meaning:
φυτεία, -ας, ἡ
(φυτεύω), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:29 (נָטַע), Mic.1:6, Eze.17:7 (מַטָּע) * ;]
1. a planting (Xen., al.; LXX).
2. = φύτευμα, that which is planted, a plant (Inscr.): Mat.15:13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
